scripts.test: cargo test --workspace --all-features && bun run nlp-app-ui:test && bun run text-wasm:test:all
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && bun run nlp-app-ui:typecheck && bun run text-app:typecheck
scripts.build: cargo build --workspace --all-features && bun run nlp-app-ui:build && bun run text-app:build
scripts.text-app:build: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; bun run nlp-app-ui:build; bun run text-wasm:build:all; for package in packages/text-*-app; do bun run --cwd "$package" build; done'
scripts.text-app:typecheck: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; for package in packages/text-*-app; do bun run --cwd "$package" typecheck; done'
scripts.text-wasm:build:all: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; for package in packages/text-*-wasm; do bun run --cwd "$package" build; done'
scripts.text-wasm:test:all: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; for package in packages/text-*-wasm; do bun run --cwd "$package" test; done'
